name: Dahut
source:
[i]"I'II leave the rest to the young ones and our not-so-young one! ★"[/i]

A boy who serves as deputy director of the National Research Institute, and is known to be a genius second only to Scien. Scien's lack of interest in life forces Dahut to take care of Scien's daily chores, despite which he is still somewhat mistreated by Scien. He is extremely friendly and loves baking.

[b]Occupation:[/b] Researcher, Deputy Director of the National Research Institute

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/vircheevermore/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]

[spoiler]His real name is Liam Rêvepoir (リアム・レーヴポワール).[/spoiler]
